description: Rescue Project task 3 (#32): Barons.market_mods(rescue) emits the open phase's site embargo AFTER every baron mod and every rival front-run mod. 'tail' is the part of the list after the barons: the first rival's standing front-run on luna MACHINERY (depth 6000), then phase 1's embargo (ask_depth_bps 0) on luna MACHINERY and ORE, commodities sorted. 'ladder_luna_machinery' is the seeded five-level book ([price, qty]) for that fold: bids see only the front-run (15+8n scaled by 6000, floor 1), asks are cut to the seeder's one-unit floor per level. Checked by game/tests/test_rescue_loop.gd.
